extracted.intended_audience: GAP users, computational group theorists, and mathematicians/programmers using GAP's group operations
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP's group-related operations and attributes (creation, subgroups, cosets, conjugacy classes, normal structure, closures, factorization, and structure description), including semantics, options, limitations and implementation notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupByGenerators vs GroupWithGenerators behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: GroupByGenerators(gens) returns the group generated by gens; if an id is present it is stored as the identity. GroupWithGenerators(gens[, id]) returns the group generated by gens and ensures the attribute GeneratorsOfGroup of the returned group is equal to gens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use GroupWithGenerators when you need the group's GeneratorsOfGroup attribute to exactly match the provided gens; GroupByGenerators may return a group whose GeneratorsOfGroup attribute differs from gens. GroupByGenerators is the underlying operation called by Group.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfGroup attribute semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: GeneratorsOfGroup(G) returns a list of generators of G. If G was created by GroupWithGenerators with argument gens, the list returned equals gens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For groups with GeneratorsOfGroup bound, individual generators can be accessed by G.i (for positive integer i). For free groups, G.name returns named generators. Note that displayed generating sets may differ from stored attribute; View methods may display limited information.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsGroup behavior (collection → group test)
rubrics_metrics.description: AsGroup(D) returns the group formed by elements of collection D if they form a group; otherwise it returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AsGroup to test whether a collection forms a group (it returns fail if not). Example: AsGroup([(1,2)]) returns fail; AsGroup([(),(1,2)]) returns Group([ (1,2) ]).

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugateGroup operation
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugateGroup(G, obj) returns the conjugate group of G obtained by applying the conjugating element obj.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can also form a conjugate using the infix operator ^. Example: ConjugateGroup(g,(1,5)) returns Group([ (2,3,4,5), (2,5) ]).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsGroup semantics (category test vs set-of-elements test)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsGroup(obj) tests whether obj fulfills the categorical conditions for a group (magma-with-inverses and associativity). It does not test whether obj is a set of elements that forms a group under multiplication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To test whether a collection of elements forms a group, use AsGroup. See category documentation for details. Example: IsGroup(g) returns true for a group object.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subgroup / SubgroupNC / Subgroup (unary) differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Subgroup(G, gens) creates the subgroup U of G generated by gens with Parent(U) = G. SubgroupNC(G, gens) does the same but does not check whether gens lie in G. Subgroup(G) (unary) creates a shell subgroup without known generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SubgroupNC only when you are sure the generators lie in G; the unary Subgroup can be used to construct a subgroup object to be specified later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index / IndexNC behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Index(G, U) returns [G:U] = |G|/|U| for subgroup U of G. IndexNC(G, U) does not check whether U is contained in G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IndexNC is faster but unsafe if U may not be a subgroup of G.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndexInWholeGroup attribute purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: IndexInWholeGroup(G) returns the index of G in P when the family of elements of G itself forms a group P; primarily used for free groups or finitely presented groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for tracking index of a represented group inside an ambient family-group.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsSubgroup behavior and parent handling
rubrics_metrics.description: AsSubgroup(G, U) creates a subgroup of G which contains the same elements as U, and sets Parent of the result to G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to move a subgroup into another group's parent relation. Example demonstrates Parent(v) becomes G.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSubgroup checks and recommended usage
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSubgroup(G, U) returns true if U is a group and U is a subset of domain G; implemented by calling IsGroup(U) and IsSubset(G, U).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special IsSubset methods may test only generators of U when available. If you already know U is a group, calling IsSubset directly is often preferable and faster.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNormal definition and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: IsNormal(G, U) returns true if G normalizes U, i.e., for every g in G and u in U the element u^g (or ug in their notation) is in U. Note: U need not be a subgroup of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use IsNormal to test normalization; example: IsNormal(g,u) may return false.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCharacteristicSubgroup definition
rubrics_metrics.description: IsCharacteristicSubgroup(G, N) tests whether N is invariant under all automorphisms of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct test for characteristic subgroups; example returns false in given case.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugateSubgroup behavior with parents
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugateSubgroup(G, g) returns the subgroup of G's parent P obtained by conjugating G using g if G has a parent; otherwise delegates to ConjugateGroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If G has no parent, result equals ConjugateGroup(G,g). Use infix ^ as alternative.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugateSubgroups returns orbit images
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugateSubgroups(G, U) returns a list of all images of U under conjugation action by G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computes the orbit of subgroup U under conjugation by G.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSubnormal definition
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSubnormal(G, U) tests whether subgroup U of G is subnormal, i.e., contained in a subnormal series of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns true/false depending on subnormality; examples illustrate both outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubgroupByProperty caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: SubgroupByProperty(G, prop) creates a subgroup of G consisting of elements fulfilling prop (a tester function), but no test is done whether the property actually defines a subgroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only limited functionality exists for such subgroups (element tests); be cautious—prop may not define a subgroup and many subgroup operations may not work as expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubgroupShell purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: SubgroupShell(G) creates a subgroup of G not yet specified further (e.g., no generators), to be defined later.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful as a placeholder to collect information about a subgroup over time or to set generators later.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClosureGroup semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: ClosureGroup(G, obj) creates the group generated by elements of G and obj, where obj may be an element or a collection (including another group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to extend a group by elements; examples show closures with individual elements and collections.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClosureGroupAddElm / ClosureGroupCompare / ClosureGroupIntest / ClosureGroupDefault role
rubrics_metrics.description: These functions implement ClosureGroup: add element to generators, remove duplicates and identity, and test containment. ClosureGroupDefault returns the closure and preserves AsSSortedList attribute when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They are the internal methods used to manage closures and to implement Enumerator/EnumeratorSorted compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClosureSubgroup / ClosureSubgroupNC parent-check behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: ClosureSubgroup(G, obj) calls ClosureGroup and if the result is subgroup of G's parent then sets its parent accordingly; ClosureSubgroupNC omits the containment check.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NC version is faster but can yield a wrong parent, which may imply incorrect properties; use with care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expressing group elements as words via homomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Use EpimorphismFromFreeGroup (attribute) to obtain a homomorphism from a free group mapping free generators to G's generators; preimages of elements under this homomorphism are words in the free generators expressing group elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Option names can prescribe print names for free generators. Use PreImagesRepresentative on the homomorphism to get explicit word expressions. Example: PreImagesRepresentative(hom,(1,4)) yields word in x,y.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factorization algorithm and limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Factorization(G, elm) returns a factorization of elm as a word in generators from GeneratorsOfGroup; the algorithm enumerates all elements to ensure a short word.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because it forms all group elements, do not use Factorization when G has more than a few million elements; do not call it inside other algorithms—use homomorphisms instead. MappingGeneratorsImages and EpimorphismFromFreeGroup attributes relate the word to generator images.

rubrics_metrics.name: GrowthFunctionOfGroup behavior and radius option
rubrics_metrics.description: GrowthFunctionOfGroup(G) computes counts of elements by shortest word length in the generating set; GrowthFunctionOfGroup(G, radius) restricts counting up to given radius. Without radius the group must be finite and all elements are enumerated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns list L where L[i+1] counts elements whose shortest expression has length i. Use radius for infinite or large groups to bound computation.

rubrics_metrics.name: StructureDescription purpose and caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: StructureDescription(G) returns a (possibly short) string giving some insight into G's structure; intended primarily for small groups (order < 100) or groups with few normal subgroups. The string is NOT an isomorphism invariant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-isomorphic groups can share strings and isomorphic groups in different representations may produce different strings. Not suitable as a research tool—useful for educational/quick summaries only. Print behavior: if Name attribute unbound but StructureDescription is, View prints StructureDescription; computing StructureDescription does not change the printed representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: StructureDescription output formats and options
rubrics_metrics.description: StructureDescription returns values like 'C<size>', 'Z', 'A<degree>', 'S<degree>', direct/semidirect product notations, library names for simple and sporadic groups, etc. Option 'short' uses abbreviated output, option 'nice' attempts to find nicer semidirect decompositions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use :short for compact representations (e.g., '6x3' instead of 'C6 x C3'). :nice may take very long for groups with many normal subgroups; :nice prefers decompositions satisfying listed heuristics (H abelian, N abelian, many abelian invariants/factors, phi injective).

rubrics_metrics.name: StructureDescription computation strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy: (1) Lookup in precomputed list for small orders (≤100 except 64,96), (2) abelian decomposition into cyclic factors, (3) recognize standard families (alternating, symmetric, dihedral, etc.), (4) decompose into direct product of irreducibles, (5) recognize semidirect products with selection preferences for N,H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If decomposition fails try perfect groups library; if all fails return a descriptive failure string. :nice alters selection preferences and may exhaustively search semidirect decompositions, increasing cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: RightCoset requirements and semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: RightCoset(U, g) returns the right coset Ug (set of all ug for u in U). The element g must be an element of some larger group G which contains U.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A right coset behaves like a set of group elements for element operations. Right cosets are external orbits for U acting via OnLeftInverse; actions of larger groups on right cosets use OnRight.

rubrics_metrics.name: RightCosets / RightCosetsNC behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: RightCosets(G, U) computes a duplicate-free list of right cosets U g for g in G; RightCosetsNC omits the check whether U is a subgroup of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The returned list yields a right transversal via representatives; inverting representatives gives left coset representatives. NC version is faster but unsafe if U may not be a subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalRightCosetElement representation dependence
rubrics_metrics.description: CanonicalRightCosetElement(U, g) returns a canonical representative of the right coset Ug independent of the given representative g, useful for comparing cosets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The chosen canonical representative is representation-dependent and only guaranteed to remain the same within one GAP session (not across sessions).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRightCoset category
rubrics_metrics.description: IsRightCoset(obj) denotes the category/type of right cosets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAP doesn't provide a separate left-coset data type; left cosets can be emulated using right cosets by inverting representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBiCoset criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: IsBiCoset(C) (property) is true iff the right coset Ug simultaneously forms a left coset for the same subgroup, equivalently iff the coset representative g normalizes U.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Test normalization of U by g to determine bicoset status.

rubrics_metrics.name: CosetDecomposition output
rubrics_metrics.description: CosetDecomposition(G, S) returns a partition of G's elements into right cosets of S as a list of lists; the first sublist lists elements of the subgroup S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for enumerating cosets explicitly; ordering of subsequent lists follows arrangement by representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: RightTransversal object behavior and PositionCanonical
rubrics_metrics.description: RightTransversal(G, U) returns an object behaving like an immutable list of length [G : U] whose elements are representatives of right cosets. PositionCanonical(t, g) returns the position of the representative in t that lies in the same coset as g (Position would return fail if element not equal to representative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RightTransversal elements are not necessarily canonical; use CanonicalRightCosetElement to compute canonical representatives. If U is trivial, RightTransversal may return a sorted plain list of representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoubleCoset construction and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: DoubleCoset(U, g, V) constructs the double coset UgV; U and V must be subgroups of a common supergroup G of which g is an element. The result stores U as LeftActingGroup, g as Representative, and V as RightActingGroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Double cosets behave like sets of group elements for element operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativesContainedRightCosets semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: RepresentativesContainedRightCosets(D) returns a set of representatives hi such that double coset D = union of U hi; the representatives are canonical for U and form a set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to decompose double coset into U-right-coset union; Representative() and stored acting groups can be inspected.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoubleCosets / DoubleCosetsNC behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: DoubleCosets(G, U, V) computes a duplicate-free list of all double cosets UgV for g in G; DoubleCosetsNC omits checks whether U and V are subgroups of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NC version faster but unsafe when subgroup status uncertain.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoubleCosetRepsAndSizes faster alternative
rubrics_metrics.description: DoubleCosetRepsAndSizes(G, U, V) returns a list of [r, n] where r is a double coset representative and n its size; faster than creating double coset objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for efficiency when only representatives and sizes are needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClass semantics and attributes
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugacyClass(G, g) creates the conjugacy class in G with representative g as an external orbit; functions like Representative, ActingDomain, StabilizerOfExternalSet and AsList work on it. The attribute Centralizer gives the centralizer of the representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conjugacy classes behave like external orbits; membership tests and representative access are supported.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClasses options and default strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugacyClasses(G) returns conjugacy class objects; identity class is guaranteed first. For small groups (≤ ~500) classes computed by orbit action by default (unless noaction set). For solvable groups default is homomorphic lift; otherwise method of [Hul00] is used. Options: random, action, noaction to influence method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generally let GAP choose method. Use :action to force orbit-action (fast for small groups but memory heavy), :random for random search (low memory, good for almost simple groups), :noaction to avoid orbit-action even for small groups when memory is constrained.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassesByRandomSearch suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugacyClassesByRandomSearch(G) computes classes by random search and works very efficiently for almost simple groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessible via ConjugacyClasses(G:random). Use for groups where random search finds class representatives quickly and when memory is limited.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugacyClassesByOrbits memory/time trade-off
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugacyClassesByOrbits(G) computes classes as orbits of G on itself; can be quick but may consume large memory for larger groups since all classes store element lists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best for small groups (roughly ≤ 10^3) where action is fastest. For groups with many classes or heavy memory usage consider random search or other methods. Examples show timing differences between options.

rubrics_metrics.name: NrConjugacyClasses utility
rubrics_metrics.description: NrConjugacyClasses(G) returns the number of conjugacy classes of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple count utility; example returns 5 for a sample group.

rubrics_metrics.name: RationalClass and RationalClasses definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: RationalClass(G, g) creates a rational class consisting of elements conjugate to g or to an i-th power of g where i is coprime to order(g). RationalClasses(G) returns a list of rational classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rational classes can be seen as conjugacy classes of cyclic subgroups; they are external sets with conjugation action but not orbits.

rubrics_metrics.name: GaloisGroup attribute of rational class
rubrics_metrics.description: GaloisGroup(ratcl) returns the subgroup of Units(Zn) consisting of exponents i for which g^i lies in the ordinary conjugacy class of g; stored in attribute GaloisGroup of rational class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computes arithmetic Galois group of exponent actions on rational class by interpreting Units( Integers mod n ).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConjugate for elements and subgroups
rubrics_metrics.description: IsConjugate(G, x, y) or IsConjugate(G, U, V) tests whether x and y (or U and V) are conjugate under action of G. Implementation is a shortcut to RepresentativeAction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements/subgroups need not be contained in G. Use RepresentativeAction to obtain a conjugating element when conjugacy holds.

rubrics_metrics.name: NthRootsInGroup functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: NthRootsInGroup(G, e, n) returns a list of all elements in G whose n-th power equals e.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to enumerate solutions to x^n = e in G; example returns two elements for a 2-root case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Normalizer usage for subgroups and elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Normalizer(G, U) computes NG(U) (stabilizer of U under conjugation by G). Normalizer(G, g) computes NG(<g>) (normalizer of subgroup generated by g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute normalizers of subgroups or cyclic subgroups generated by an element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core (intersection of conjugates) definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Core(S, U) returns the core of U in S, i.e., the intersection of all S-conjugates of U, assuming S and U are groups of elements in the same family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard normal-core computation; example shows Core returns trivial group in sample.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCore (p-core) definition and relation to Sylow core
rubrics_metrics.description: PCore(G, p) is the largest normal p-subgroup of G; it equals the core of a Sylow p-subgroup of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates equality PCore(G,p) = Core(G, SylowSubgroup(G,p)).

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalClosure definitions and usages
rubrics_metrics.description: NormalClosure(G, U) returns the normal closure of U in G: the smallest normal subgroup of closure(G ∪ U) containing U. Second argument may be a list of elements (interpreted as generators for closure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to compute the subgroup generated by all conjugates of U (or of provided elements). Examples illustrate equality to expected generated groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalIntersection faster conditional computation
rubrics_metrics.description: NormalIntersection(G, U) computes intersection of G and U under the assumption that G is normalized by U; this is faster than Intersection but will not produce the intersection if G is not normalized by U.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only use when normalization condition holds; otherwise Intersection should be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComplementClassesRepresentatives scope limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: ComplementClassesRepresentatives(G, N) returns representatives for conjugacy classes of complements of normal subgroup N in G, i.e., subgroups that intersect N trivially and together generate G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currently methods are available only when N or G/N is solvable; use accordingly. Example shows a returned complement representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information classes (InfoGroup, InfoCoset, InfoComplement)
rubrics_metrics.description: InfoGroup, InfoCoset, InfoComplement denote info classes (verbosity/debugging classes) for the respective groups of functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set or query these info classes to get debugging/verbosity output from GAP's internals for these areas.
